clue.text: Give voice about the Left, being absolutely fair

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other, here the singing word wraps the side

parts.note: to give voice is to sing
port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone speaks up for the political Left and claims to be utterly even-handed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal. 'Left' looks political but means the nautical side of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporting gesture is a generous, even-handed one, in keeping with fair play.

clue.text: Bend requiring good man, mature

parts.note: ST, saint, is a good person
ripe means fully mature

explanation.surface: A bending path needs a fine fellow of full age.
explanation.walkthrough: In heraldry a bend is a diagonal band across a shield.
explanation.definitionFit: A heraldic bend is a diagonal band or strip crossing the shield.

clue.text: Unconventional aim can cause disgust

parts.note: off as in offbeat, out of the ordinary
an end is a purpose or aim

explanation.surface: An odd goal may repel people.
explanation.definitionFit: To affront or repel people is to provoke their disgust.

clue.text: Floods responsible for rock fractures

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
rents are tears or splits

explanation.surface: Water torrents are blamed for cracks in the stone.
explanation.walkthrough: A tor is a rocky outcrop on a hilltop, common on English moors.
explanation.definitionFit: Violent rushing streams of water amount to floods.

clue.text: He has one crumpled pound

indicators.note: crumpled means crushed out of shape, so the word one is rearranged

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound sterling

explanation.surface: A man holding a single creased pound note.
explanation.definitionFit: A male given name, so it can stand for a man.

clue.text: Fast horses

definitions.meaning: fast in the sense of firmly fixed and secure
a group of racehorses in one yard

explanation.surface: A note on quick racehorses.
explanation.definitionFit: Fast as in firmly fixed, steady; and a collection of racehorses kept by one owner or trainer.

clue.text: Mark's secure after backing up a renegade

indicators.note: after puts the securing word behind the reversed one
backing up in a down clue means the word reads upwards, in reverse

parts.note: a rat is a deserter or turncoat
to get is to obtain or secure

explanation.surface: Mark makes safe after supporting a traitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A goal aimed at is a mark to shoot at.

clue.text: Jewellery people left in punt

indicators.note: in places the people and the side inside the wager

parts.note: a punt is a gamble or bet
a race is a people or nation

explanation.surface: Folk left their jewels in a small boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punt' suggests a flat river boat; in British slang it is a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: A band worn around the wrist as an ornament is a piece of jewellery.

clue.text: It's late in the day for a regular course

parts.note: even means regular or uniform
a tide is a course or flow

explanation.surface: Too late in the day for a steady routine.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening time comes at the close of the day.

clue.text: Progressive person calling for military force no longer

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
former means what used to be but is no longer

explanation.surface: A forward-looking campaigner urges an end to armed force.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army; 'calling for' just links the pieces to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone pushing for social or political improvement is a progressive campaigner for change.

clue.text: Found note in box

indicators.note: in signals that the musical note sits inside the box word

parts.note: a crate is a wooden box
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A note discovered inside a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Found' looks like the past of find; here it is the verb meaning to establish.
explanation.definitionFit: To found something, such as a school, is to bring it into being.

clue.text: The decoration of a sound receiver

definitions.text: The decoration of a sound receiver

parts.words: The decoration of a sound receiver
parts.note: sound receiver suggests a radio, but it is the hearing organ, decorated with jewellery

explanation.surface: An ornament fitted to a radio set.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of jewellery worn on the lobe adorns the hearing organ.

clue.text: Shut up and wrote

definitions.meaning: confined in a pen or enclosure
set down in writing with a pen

explanation.surface: Someone was locked away and spent the time writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals are confined in a pen, and an author puts words down with a pen.

clue.text: Ben's mate is bent-not on the level

indicators.note: bent means twisted out of shape, so the letters before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ben's friend is crooked and not to be trusted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not on the level' reads as dishonest, continuing 'bent', but means below ground level.
explanation.definitionFit: A cellar storey lies below street level rather than at it.

clue.text: A lack of religious belief set him a problem

indicators.note: a problem means the words before it are puzzled into a new order

explanation.surface: His unbelief posed a difficulty for him.
explanation.definitionFit: Disbelief in any god is the absence of religious faith.

clue.text: They say it's obsolete coinage

definitions.meaning: ancient Greek coins no longer in use

explanation.surface: People repeat that the money is out of date.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who declare things are declarers; and the ancient Greek gold or silver stater coins are long out of circulation.

clue.text: Most important deal arranged

indicators.note: arranged means put into a new order, so the word deal is rearranged

explanation.surface: A key deal has been set up.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal role or position is the foremost one.

clue.text: Gather a number on the roadside

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
the verge is the grass strip at a road's edge

explanation.surface: A crowd assembles by the road.
explanation.walkthrough: A verge is the grassy edge beside a British road.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet at one point, coming together, is to gather.

clue.text: Warrants speculators brought to light

parts.note: bears are stock market speculators betting on falling prices
out means revealed or made known

explanation.surface: Arrest warrants for market dealers come to light.
explanation.definitionFit: To support or confirm a claim is to justify or warrant it.

clue.text: Serve, possibly in party that's most strict

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the group word

parts.note: a set is a group or party

indicators.note: possibly means the word Serve could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Serve, perhaps, at the strictest of gatherings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' signals the anagram of the first word, and 'in' puts that shuffle inside the group word; 'Serve' looks like a tennis instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of harsh or stern: the strictest, harshest possible.

clue.text: Not all allow entrance to man

indicators.note: Not all says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Not everyone may be admitted to the gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's given name, used for an individual male.

clue.text: Twist the German after tight start

indicators.note: after places the German article behind the stingy word

parts.note: tight means mean with money
der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: Turning the German around after a tense opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts the German article behind the stingy word; 'start' only says that word comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind and turn along a winding course, as a river does.

clue.text: Attachment for former husband admitted by a woman

indicators.note: admitted by means the ex goes inside the woman's name

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name
an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: A side building for an ex-husband, let in by a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: An extension added onto a building, or an appended document, is an attachment.

clue.text: Mothers stream out

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of stream are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mothers pour out of the building.
explanation.walkthrough: Mater is old public-school slang for mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Mater is Latin and old British slang for mother.

clue.text: A scientist's novel, not badly written

parts.note: novel means new

indicators.note: badly written means the word not is mis-spelt, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A scientist's book that is reasonably well crafted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac Newton was the English physicist behind the laws of motion.

clue.text: No severe get-up for an artist

indicators.note: a get-up is a costume or rig-out, so the letters are dressed in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An artist is told there is no need for a stern outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: Paolo Veronese was a 16th-century Venetian painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Paolo Veronese was a Venetian Renaissance painter.

clue.text: Discuss a letter about a cricketer

indicators.note: about says the letter's name wraps round the cricketer

parts.note: dee is the spelt-out name of the letter D
a bat is a batsman in cricket

explanation.surface: Talking over a letter written about a cricket player.
explanation.definitionFit: To argue a matter out formally is to debate it, a synonym of discuss.

clue.text: A prima-donna can turn greedy

indicators.note: turn means the word for greedy is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: avid means eager or greedy

explanation.surface: A star soprano may become grasping.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrated opera singer, the leading lady of the company.

clue.text: Making port, Edward was really boisterous

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian port
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Edward got rowdy as he arrived in harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Running wild in a disorderly crowd is a violent outburst of rowdiness.

clue.text: A hold-up at sea

parts.note: hold-up reads as a robbery or delay but means something that keeps a person afloat in the water

explanation.surface: A robbery or delay happening on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: A buoyant ring thrown to a swimmer keeps them up in the water.

clue.text: An admission of course

definitions.meaning: the right to enter somewhere, access
a dish served as part of a meal

explanation.surface: A confession, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Entry or access to a society; and a main dish in a meal, especially in American usage.

clue.text: Champion the quiet worker

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet
an artisan is a skilled craft worker

explanation.surface: A hero who is the silent labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: A committed supporter who fights for a cause is its champion.
